title: Optimal Binary Search Tree
constraints: Keys are distinct and sorted in increasing order.
Frequencies are non-negative integers, and the cost fits in a safe JavaScript integer.
inputFormat: Implement optimalBST(keys, freq). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the minimum sum of frequency × level over every key, with root level 1.
